handback.summary: Added a Kimi adapter that puts the stored sign-in back, then starts Kimi with the role's model.

criteria.699.1: `dokima/agent_kimi.py` `run()` starts `kimi -p PROMPT --model MODEL --output-format stream-json` and returns Kimi's exit code.
criteria.699.2: `dokima/agent_kimi.py` `restore_sign_in()` unpacks the stored base64 gzip tar into the home folder before Kimi starts.

raises.label: Tests read runner settings
raises.text: Nine agent interface tests fail on a runner because the runner's settings path leaks into them.
raises.evidence: `tests/test_agents.py` keeps `DOKIMA_SETTINGS`; 9 fail with it set, all pass with `env -u DOKIMA_SETTINGS`.
